responsibility: Declares the CRIS GNU/Linux-specific target options layered on top of the base CRIS option set. This option table provides the legacy -mlinux switch and the Linux/ELF PIC-related GOTPLT controls (-mgotplt and -mno-gotplt), mapping them to the AVOID_GOTPLT target mask so the driver and backend can parse Linux-specific code-generation choices for position-independent calls and linkage behavior.
same_name_distinction: Option-description file for the CRIS GNU/Linux variant: it defines the Linux-specific -m switches, especially the legacy -mlinux flag and GOTPLT control options mapped to AVOID_GOTPLT. Unlike linux.h, it does not provide target macros or specs for the Linux subtarget; it only tells GCC how to parse and expose those command-line options.
